## Verification Complete

I've assessed the subscriber importer and written findings to **ASSESSMENT.md**. 

**Critical issue identified**: The importer reports success but stores all data exclusively in-memory (a Go map). When the program exits, every imported subscriber is permanently lost. There is no database, file storage, or any persistence mechanism—explaining why subscribers go missing despite success reporting.

**Additional findings**: 
- Silent error handling masks file/CSV failures
- Duplicate emails silently overwrite, creating count mismatches
- No email or plan validation occurs

The five highest-value findings document this root cause and related data-integrity issues.
